title: Automations
subtitle: Deterministic trigger → condition → action rules. Start from a safety template or build your own.

sections.ifHint: All conditions must hold (AND). No conditions = always.
sections.noConditions: No conditions — the rule fires whenever a trigger matches.

action.messageHelper: Shown in Activity and sent to enabled channels
action.sceneHelper: The scene to activate when this rule runs
action.noScenes: No scenes yet — create one on the Scenes page first

onTimeout.title: On timeout
onTimeout.hint: Runs only if the wait timed out instead of matching. Ends the action sequence — it does not resume after this branch.

onError.title: On error
onError.hint: Runs if this action fails at runtime, instead of aborting the whole rule run. Use {error} in a message to include the error text. Ends the action sequence.

templates.gallerySubtitle: Configurable protective rules. Pick one, bind it to your own sensor and save — nothing runs until you do.
